subject.title: [Bug]: iOS chat content meets opaque black bands at screen edges

question: Should the iOS owners accept the linked PR's restoration of the layered Chat canvas and land it after a current-head simulator review?
rationale: The protected maintainer label and a user-visible native presentation change require explicit owner judgment even though the report and candidate PR describe a narrow regression repair.

options.title: Review and land the candidate fix
options.body: Confirm the current-head simulator behavior in dark and light appearance, then merge the narrow canvas restoration if it preserves the existing composer and conversation presentation.

options.title: Request a narrower or revised repair
options.body: Keep the issue and candidate PR open if current-head review shows the change alters unrelated Chat presentation or does not cover the reported edge treatment.

recommendation.title: Review and land the candidate fix
recommendation.body: Confirm the current-head simulator behavior in dark and light appearance, then merge the narrow canvas restoration if it preserves the existing composer and conversation presentation.

likelyOwner.reason: The report traces the behavior to the native iOS presentation refactor authored by marvkr; steipete is the appropriate contributor for the proposed repair.
